the presence of early‐onset atopic dermatitis (AD) is associated with increased T helper 2 (Th2) and decreased regulatory T cell (Treg) responses in 11 year‐old children.

the early‐onset atopic phenotype is characterized by a more pro‐inflammatory T helper (Th) 2‐biased immune profile, as evidenced by increased Th2 cytokine production and decreased T regulatory (Treg) cell numbers and cytokine production in peripheral blood.
